title.en: Artifact Injection to Boost Anomaly Detection in Kidney Single-Cell Omics
title.zh: 用伪影注入增强肾脏单细胞异常检测

lead.en: Learn normal kidney from healthy data, then flag what it cannot explain; one modality is evidence on another.
lead.zh: 从健康数据学习正常肾脏，再标出它解释不了的细胞和区域；用一个模态作为另一个模态的证据。

title.en: Verifiable Research Agents for Chronic Kidney Disease: A Rule-Engine Harness with Experts in the Loop
title.zh: 可检验的 CKD 科研 agent：规则引擎驱动、专家参与、不断进步的 harness

lead.en: A harness around any research agent: a rule engine checks CKD claims on domain knowledge, data and analysis code; experts review the selected claims; their verdicts become rules.
lead.zh: 包在任何科研 agent 外面的 harness：规则引擎从领域知识、数据和分析代码三层检查 CKD 结论；专家判定被挑出的论断；判断变成新规则。

title.zh: 桥：多个课题共用的论文

lead.en: Papers that more than one research topic depends on.
lead.zh: 不止一个研究课题要用到的论文。
